fixtures.derivation: Captured 81ace2a initializer, decoded with the 81ace2a Markets IDL and re-encoded with the 2f0a2ce IDL. The removed fee fields and conviction_reference_margin_ppb are replaced by FeeConfig {platform_buy 100, platform_sell 100, platform_claim 100, platform_back 300, platform_unback 300, backer_trade 100, prize_min 100, buy_prize_max 500, sell_prize_max 9800, sell_progress_delay_factor 16, sell_gap_weight 10000, buy_reference_threshold_ppb 700000000}. Every other field keeps its captured value. The af0d6bb FeeConfig replaces platform_general_fee_bps with platform_back_fee_bps and platform_unback_fee_bps; both keep the earlier general rate, which applied to back and unback.
